notes.title: OnSlaught Devlog #3 Is Here!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=pd3a2DfC-6k;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Hey you lovely OnSlaught supporters![/h2] 
I made a recent devlog showing off some new gameplay and behind the scenes work I have been doing for OnSlaught. If you are at all interested in how this game is being developed, or just interested in how games are made in general, I’d highly suggest you check it out!

A demo is coming out SOON, I promise ~♥
